topRepos.name: Catto-web-extension
topRepos.description: Catto is a Chrome and Edge browser extension that adds an AI-powered cat assistant to any webpage. It reads the page content, understands the page structure, and lets users chat with a floating cat widget to ask questions or request simple in-page changes.
